name: Deliver Newspaper by Clearing For Sale Sign
description: The newspaper flies through the air, knocking a 'For Sale - price reduced!' sign off the front lawn. It lands with a thud on the steps, settling into place.
related_events: Newspaper lands on steps after removing for sale sign

name: Paul Leaves Store with Purchase and Drives Away
description: Paul exits the store carrying a shopping bag, walks to his car, gets inside, and drives away.
related_events: Paul exits store with shopping bag
Paul drives away in his car

name: Paul Arrives at the Strip Mall
description: Paul steers his Ford Taurus onto the cracked parking pad of a rundown strip mall on the edge of the city. The car rolls to a stop amid flickering signs and the distant hum of traffic. Around him, the buildings sag under peeling paint and boarded windows—the Porn-a-copia video store, a fish and chips joint with a broken neon tube, a small engine repair shop cluttered with parts, a hair stylist with an unlit salon sign, and the Barnell Great Escapes travel agency behind dusty glass. A large trash dumpster hulks in the corner, streaked with grime. The sun dips low, casting long shadows across the lot as steam rises from nearby heat vents.
related_events: Paul arrives at the strip mall in his Ford Taurus

name: Children Sledding on Improvised Sleds
description: On the outskirts of the city, a group of children laugh as they slide down a snow-covered hill. They ride on toboggans, inner tubes, and flattened cardboard boxes, speeding over the slick surface. The sky above is gray and low, and the hill stands alone, surrounded by open, quiet land.
related_events: Children slide down snow-covered hill on improvised sleds

name: Paul Spills Coffee and Retrieves Soaked Papers
description: Paul is driving while talking on his cell phone and holding a metallic travel coffee mug. As he speaks, he taps the brakes too hard, causing the mug to fall. The lid pops off, and coffee spills onto a stack of papers, soaking them. He pulls the car over, parks, then gets out and gathers the wet documents.
related_events: Paul drops coffee on stack of papers while driving
Paul parks car and retrieves soaked papers

name: Paul Transporting a Corpse on a Surfboard Across Snow
description: Paul, wearing snowshoes, pushes a corpse across a snowy landscape. The body is dressed in Raymond's clothing and a blue parka, lying face up on an Aloha Airlines promotional surfboard. A second pair of snowshoes rests on the corpse's chest. The board lurches forward as Paul moves ahead. Somewhere, a wolf howls.
related_events: Paul moves corpse on surfboard

name: Paul Descends the Rock Face and Examines the Corpse
description: Paul carefully makes his way down the rocky slope, holding a shopping bag. He reaches the corpse and crouches nearby. In an exaggerated British accent, he says, 'You may want to take a gander. You may want to take a gander...'
related_events: Paul descends rock face with shopping bag toward corpse
Paul speaks in exaggerated British accent

name: Paul Disposes of the Corpse Down the Drop
description: Paul rolled the corpse over the edge of the 25-foot drop. The body, wearing the spare snowshoes, tumbled down the slope, bouncing until it came to rest in the snow with a soft whump.
related_events: Paul rolls corpse down a 25-foot drop
Corpse lands in the snow after falling

name: Man Disposes of Stolen Mini-Bar Fridge at Night
description: The lid of the bin reopens under the dim glow of a newly lit streetlamp. A middle-aged man in work clothes glances around, making sure no one is nearby. Satisfied, he gently lowers the bin lid, then opens it again moments later, this time maneuvering a mini-bar fridge from his shoulder. He drops the appliance into the bin, closes the lid, and quickly walks away, disappearing into the night.
related_events: Man checks surroundings for solitude at night
Man places mini-bar fridge into bin
Man flees after disposing of fridge

name: Paul confirms payment and disposes of documents during phone call
description: Paul, still on the phone, walks to the dumpster carrying a set of papers. As he speaks, he says the check was sent out a week ago and mentions he watched his secretary write it up. He then drops the papers into the dumpster.
related_events: Paul carries papers to the dumpster while on the phone
Paul confirms check was sent a week ago

name: Wolves Emerge and Approach the Corpse
description: A wolf steps into the moonlight, its eyes reflecting the pale light. Another follows, then another, until a group of wolves forms. They move together across the open ground, silent and steady, closing in on a motionless figure lying in the clearing. The wolves circle the corpse, their breath visible in the cold air, as the first one lowers its head toward the body.
related_events: Wolf emerges in moonlight
Pack of wolves approaches corpse

name: Paul Arrives and Prepares in the Car
description: A car pulls up at a remote forest turnout where two houses sit apart—a cozy, lived-in cabin farther up the road and a rundown, seemingly abandoned mobile home nearby. Inside the car, Paul adjusts a pillow taped to his stomach, then pulls a blue ski mask over his head.
related_events: Car arrives at forest turnout with two houses
Paul adjusts taped pillow and puts on blue ski mask

name: Close the dumpster after tossing in garbage bags
description: The dumpster lid slams shut. A moment later, it swings open again. Two garbage bags are hurled into the dumpster, striking the inside of the lid. The lid falls closed with a loud clang and remains shut.
related_events: Dumpster lid slams shut after being closed abruptly
Dumpster lid reopens shortly after being closed
Garbage bags are thrown into the dumpster with force

name: Mrs. Wherry Thanks Paul for Clearing the Driveway
description: Mrs. Wherry stands in her kitchen, speaking on the phone. Behind her, a large antelope head is mounted on the wall. She thanks Paul for clearing the driveway, saying it was considerate of him and that she saw him at the cabin that morning. Paul responds, saying he doesn’t understand, and that he didn’t clear the driveway.
related_events: Mrs. Wherry thanks Paul for clearing the driveway
Paul denies clearing the driveway
Mrs. Wherry mentions seeing Paul at the cabin in the morning

name: Gary and Jimbo Intervene in Snowrider Dispute
description: Gary and Jimbo step out of their car and see a boy in a red parka pulling at Gary's nephew's Snowrider, trying to take it. The nephew resists, shouting, 'Leggo... it's mine, Uncle Gary!' as the struggle continues.
related_events: Bully attempts to steal nephew's Snowrider
Gary and Jimbo exit car and witness Snowrider conflict
Nephew calls for help from Uncle Gary

name: Teenager Disposes of Garbage in the Morning
description: The dumpster reopens. Morning now. A Korean-American teenager wearing an apron and headphones sings along to an old KISS tune as he carries two large orange garbage bags. He lifts the bags one by one and drops them into the dumpster. After letting the lid fall, he pauses, then pushes it shut with care. The lid closes fully. He turns away.
related_events: Teenager sings along to KISS song during morning routine
Teenager disposes of garbage bags at dumpster
Teenager closes dumpster lid carefully

name: Hair Stylist Disposes of Samples and Shares a Bus Encounter
description: On a bitterly cold, gray winter's day in an Alaskan city, a chunky hair stylist with jet black bangs opens a dumpster and shakes out a box of conditioning samples. As the wind bites the air, the stylist speaks to someone off-screen, recounting a moment from earlier: a woman on the bus said she hadn't eaten all day, then pulled out a salmon steak and began eating it.
related_events: Hair stylist shakes out box of conditioning samples in dumpster
Hair stylist recounts story about woman eating salmon steak on bus

name: Dumping the Body in the Garbage
description: The lid of the garbage container creaks open. A lifeless man's body crashes into the bin. Sirens wail in the distance. A man in silhouette reaches in, grabbing handfuls of trash to throw over the corpse. Another man appears, grabs the first by the arm, and pulls him back. 'We'll get him later. C'mon.' The lid slams shut.
related_events: Body dumped into garbage container
Man covers corpse with garbage
Second man pulls accomplice away from container
Container lid closes after disposal

name: Paul at the Cliff Edge with the Surfboard
description: Paul, wearing snowshoes and carrying a surfboard, crouches at the edge of the cliff and peers over. Below, the corpse lies exactly as it did the night before. He leans forward, then calls out, 'Well come on! How much easier do I have to make this?' His voice carries across the empty wilderness, echoing in the cold air.
related_events: Paul peers over the edge at the corpse
Paul calls out in frustration

name: Detective Boyle Spots Woman Skipping on Highway
description: The Corporal drives down the road, describing a man who lost his hand and walked five miles through the bush before collapsing on the highway. Detective Boyle, sitting beside him, looks ahead and sees a woman in her pajamas and a parka skipping down the middle of the road. He interrupts the story to point her out.
related_events: Corporal drives while recounting a story about a man with a severed hand
Detective Boyle interrupts the story upon spotting a woman on the road
Woman in pajamas and parka skips down the middle of the highway

name: Responders Arrive and Secure the Scene
description: Snowmobiles roar into the pull-off area where Paul had stopped, followed by an ambulance and State Conservation vehicles. Crews move quickly through the deep snow, spreading across the site. Yellow police tape is strung between fir trees, forming a marked path that leads toward the ridge. As responders and others walk through the area, their footsteps obscure the tracks Paul had left behind.
related_events: Snowmobiles arrive at the site with urgency
Ambulance and State Conservation vehicles converge on the pull-off area
Police tape is erected between fir trees leading toward the ridge
People walk through deep snow disrupting Paul's tracks

name: Paul Responds to the Microwave and Leaves the Kitchen
description: Paul sits motionless at the kitchen table. The microwave emits a sharp ding. He stands, walks to the appliance, opens it, and takes out his coffee. He glances at his watch, then walks out of the kitchen.
related_events: Paul snaps out of catatonic state at kitchen table
Microwave signals completion with a ding
Paul retrieves reheated coffee from microwave
Paul exits the kitchen after checking his watch

name: Paul Explains Raymond's Absence
description: Paul shakes off his boots and speaks on the phone. He says Raymond must have been the one involved in whatever was discussed, expressing surprise on their behalf. When asked about Raymond’s whereabouts, Paul explains that Raymond is indisposed and won’t be available, but assures the caller they’ll see him again. He adds that Raymond will be staying at the cabin for a while, until he leaves.
related_events: Paul denies Raymond's current availability
Paul states Raymond will stay at the cabin

name: Paul Arrives and Removes His Boots
description: Paul steps in and shakes off his boots, settling into the space.
related_events: Paul removes his boots

name: Paul Checks the News and Speaks to the Corpse
description: Paul sits on the hood of his car, flipping through the Morning News. He scans each section carefully, then closes the paper and stands. He walks over to the fridge, its door still padlocked. He looks at it and says, 'I don't know what kind of man let's himself just freeze to death in the trash, but I was never one to preach. Way I see it, you've probably got family somewhere and they'd probably appreciate seeing you get a decent funeral, even if it's not really... yours.' He pauses, then reaches out and gently pats the fridge door before standing there in silence.
related_events: Paul reads the Morning News on his car hood
Paul speaks to the corpse inside the padlocked fridge
Paul gently pats the fridge door containing the corpse

name: Pull Over and Open the Trunk
description: Paul sings along to 'Escape' on the radio, his voice tense. He steers the car off the wilderness road and stops at a turnout. In the dark, he switches off the headlights. The engine falls silent. He leans forward, reaches for the lever, and pops the trunk open.
related_events: Paul pulls car over on wilderness road and turns off headlights
Paul opens the trunk of his car

name: Paul Sings Along to 'Escape' on the Radio
description: Paul sits in the car, the radio playing 'Escape.' He sings along, his voice blending with the music. The headlights cut off as he pulls onto a turnout. The engine quiets. He reaches over and pops the trunk.
related_events: Paul sings along to 'Escape' on the radio while nervous

name: Paul Examines the Body in the Garage
description: Paul found a lifeless body in the garage. He propped the man against the hood of his car and looked him over carefully, checking for wounds and searching through his pockets. He found no obvious injuries and nothing in the pockets. After the search, he moved to the fridge and began pulling things out.
related_events: Paul discovers lifeless body in garage
Paul searches body for wounds and belongings

name: Paul Takes Items from the Refrigerator
description: Paul closes the fridge door after examining the body. He opens it again and begins pulling items out, setting them aside on the nearby surface. Cans of pop and beer clink as he moves them, making space for the objects he removes from the back. He sets a jar, a wrapped package, and a small tool aside, then pauses, looking at what he has taken out.
related_events: Paul removes items from refrigerator

name: Detective Boyle Responds to Woman's Fall
description: The police car pulls to a stop just as the woman completes a pirouette and falls backward onto the ground. Detective Boyle and the other officer exit the vehicle and approach her. The corporal speaks into his radio, beginning a call for a first responder, but Detective Boyle interrupts him. The woman suddenly kicks one leg into the air and wiggles her foot. Without further hesitation, Detective Boyle states he knows where she belongs. The officers reach down and lift her up.
related_events: Woman performs pirouette and falls backwards
Detective Boyle cancels first responder request
Woman kicks up leg and wiggles foot

name: Detective Boyle and Officer Help Woman to Her Feet
description: The police car comes to a stop as the woman spins and falls backward onto the ground. Detective Boyle and the other officer step out and approach her. One speaks into his radio, reporting the need for a first responder, but Detective Boyle interrupts, stopping the call. The woman suddenly kicks one leg into the air and wiggles her foot. Without further hesitation, Detective Boyle and the officer reach down, take hold of her, and lift her to her feet.
related_events: Officers lift woman from the ground

name: Margaret Vacuums as the Machine Roars to Life
description: Margaret pushes the vacuum across the floor, humming to herself. The vacuum suddenly roars to life with a loud noise, but she does not flinch or pause, continuing her cleaning with steady focus.
related_events: Margaret vacuums the floor while humming
Margaret continues without reacting to the vacuum noise

name: Paul Plugs in the Vacuum and Leaves
description: Margaret pushes the vacuum across the floor, humming to herself. Paul walks by, slipping into his coat. He sees that the vacuum is unplugged, walks over, and plugs it into the outlet. The vacuum roars to life. Margaret does not react. Paul turns and walks out the door.
related_events: Paul walks by while putting on his coat
Paul notices the vacuum is unplugged
Paul plugs in the vacuum cleaner
Vacuum turns on and roars to life
Paul exits the building through the door

name: Gary and Jimbo After the Incident
description: Gary and Jimbo sit in their car in a parking area. Jimbo asks which one is Gary's sister's kid, and Gary points to a boy on a small bike. Jimbo hesitates, then asks if Gary has been alright since what happened with the man. Gary says he thought it might bother him, but he's been sleeping well. Jimbo notes it's the first time for both of them. Gary doesn't respond. Jimbo adds that, of course, Gary didn't actually do it, then mimics snapping a neck. The gesture seems uncomfortable for him. As Gary looks at him, a Cadillac pulls up beside their car, driven by Dave, a well-dressed man in his fifties with a thuggish air. Gary and Jimbo exchange a nervous glance.
related_events: Jimbo asks Gary about handling the recent violent incident
Gary reports sleeping well after the violent incident
Jimbo mimics snapping someone's neck

name: Dave Arrives in a Cadillac
description: A Cadillac pulls up and parks beside the car where Gary and Jimbo are sitting. The two men exchange a nervous look as Dave, a well-dressed man in his fifties with a thuggish demeanor, steps out from behind the wheel.
related_events: Cadillac arrives and parks beside Gary and Jimbo's car
Gary and Jimbo exchange nervous look upon Dave's arrival

name: Paul and Margaret Reunite After Work
description: Paul walks in from the garage, pulling off his blue parka, the pillow taped to his front still in place. Margaret enters from the living room and gently pokes the pillow with her finger, then lets her hand drop. She asks if Raymond is here. Paul tells her not to worry, that Raymond probably won’t be around much longer. Margaret exhales and smiles, her shoulders relaxing. The phone rings, and Paul reaches for it.
related_events: Paul enters from the garage wearing a parka with a pillow taped to his front
Margaret enters from the living room and pokes the pillow on Paul's front
Margaret expresses nervousness about Raymond's presence
Paul reassures Margaret about Raymond leaving soon
Margaret smiles in relief after Paul's reassurance

name: Paul Answers the Ringing Phone
description: The phone rings, cutting through the quiet. Paul reaches for it and picks up the receiver.
related_events: The phone rings and Paul answers it

name: Paul Prepares the Corpse with Bacon and Lard
description: Paul pulls the bacon hat snug onto the corpse's head. He takes bloody steaks from the shopping bag and smears them across the parka. Drops of blood fall to the snow at the body's feet and vanish. He tucks one steak under the corpse's arm, drapes another from a pocket. Then he opens a container of lard and spreads it over the dead man's face. After a pause, Paul pats the shoulder and looks up toward the ridge and the long journey ahead.
related_events: Paul places the bacon hat on the corpse's head
Paul smears bloody steaks on the corpse's parka
Paul tucks steaks into the corpse's pockets and under an arm
Paul smears lard on the corpse's face

name: Paul Prepares the Corpse and Faces the Ridge
description: Paul pulls the bacon hat snug onto the corpse's head and smears bloody steaks over the parka, draping them under an arm and from a pocket. Drops of blood fall to the snow at the body's feet and vanish. He opens a container of lard and spreads it across the dead man's face, fighting his own revulsion. 'Sorry about this part,' he says. He pats the corpse on the shoulder, then looks up at the ridge, toward the long journey ahead.
related_events: Paul apologizes to the corpse
Paul pats the corpse on the shoulder
Paul looks toward the ridge and assesses the journey ahead

name: Watters Plays Video Game at Work
description: Watters sits at his desk in his cubicle, fingers moving quickly over the keyboard. From a distance, it looks like he is working. The screen reveals a chaotic video game scene: pixelated zombies collapse under a barrage of gunfire. A Miami Dolphins sticker is stuck to the side of his monitor. The game continues silently, unnoticed by nearby coworkers.
related_events: Watters types frantically at his computer in his cubicle
Watters plays a zombie video game on his work computer

name: Ted's Off-Screen Invitation
description: Ted's voice comes from off-screen, addressing Howard directly. The office workers turn their attention to Howard, their faces showing clear admiration. Howard remains motionless, staring straight ahead in stunned silence as the moment lingers.
related_events: Ted speaks from off-screen to initiate conversation with Howard
Office workers observe Howard with visible admiration
Howard stares at the camera in stunned silence

name: Ted Acknowledges Applause and Mutters Bitter Remark
description: As the tape ends, a few colleagues clap lightly. Ted lifts a hand in a small wave over the cubicle wall, offering a polite gesture of thanks. Under his breath, he mutters, 'After all they've done for me,' his tone laced with bitterness.
related_events: Colleagues applaud after the tape finishes
Ted waves over the cubicle wall to acknowledge the applause
Ted expresses bitter gratitude toward Liberty Capital in a private remark

name: Paul Starts the Snowblower
description: Paul undoes the bungee cord securing the snowblower in the trunk and pulls the machine out. He pulls the starter cord, and the engine sputters to life. With the snowblower running, he begins directing it across the driveway, clearing a path through the snow.
related_events: Paul removes snowblower from trunk using bungee cord
Paul starts snowblower engine

name: Paul Clears the Shared Driveway with the Snowblower
description: Paul undoes the bungee cord and pulls the snowblower from the trunk. He starts the machine and begins clearing the driveway that leads to both houses. Snow sprays to the side as he guides the snowblower down the length of the drive. Mrs. Wherry, an elderly woman in her bathrobe, watches from the window of her cozy cabin. She waves hesitantly at the man in the blue parka. He waves back without stopping.
related_events: Paul clears driveway of both houses with snowblower

name: Paul and Mrs. Wherry Exchange Waves
description: Mrs. Wherry, an elderly woman in her bathrobe, looks out the window of her cozy cabin and sees Paul dragging a snowblower from his trunk. He starts clearing the driveway, the engine roaring to life. She watches for a moment, a look of mild confusion crossing her face, then raises her hand to wave. Paul, bundled in a blue parka, sees her and waves back.
related_events: Mrs. Wherry observes Paul from cabin window
Mrs. Wherry waves to man in blue parka
Paul waves back to Mrs. Wherry

name: Paul's Phone Call with the Electric Company
description: Paul holds a phone to his neck as he opens a trash can, flipping through wet pages to check their contents. He stammers into the phone, insisting he pays his bills and questioning whether the problem might be on the electric company's end. Outside, men from Rodney's Repo Ranch walk toward his office. Distracted, Paul loses his grip on the phone. It slips, falling into the trash. He mutters and leans in after it, pushing aside a garbage bag, following the faint sound of the still-speaking representative. His hand freezes as he sees a body—a man in a cheap suit, pale and bluish—lying in the trash. The phone rests across the man's mouth, the voice from the line barely audible.
related_events: Paul speaks with the electric company on the phone
Men from Rodney's Repo Ranch approach Paul's office
Phone slips and falls into the trash

name: Paul Retrieves Phone and Finds Corpse in Trash
description: Paul mutters to himself as he leans into the trash to retrieve his fallen phone. He pushes aside an orange garbage bag, guided by the faint sound of the caller still speaking. As he reaches in, his eyes land on a body—a man in his forties, pale, wearing a cheap suit. The phone rests across the man’s mouth, as if he were speaking.
related_events: Paul leans in to retrieve the phone while muttering
Paul discovers a corpse in the trash
Paul's phone lies across the corpse's mouth

name: Paul Checks the Trash Before Disposing
description: Paul opens the lid of the trash can and sifts through the soggy pages inside, examining each one carefully. He holds the phone to his ear, still talking, as he flips through the damp papers to make sure nothing important is being thrown away.
related_events: Paul checks soggy pages in the trash

name: Ted Hides Game as Cam Arrives
description: Cam, a Native-American Alaskan in his 30s, walks over. Ted quickly presses a key, switching the screen from a violent computer game to a spreadsheet. Cam says it was cool, like watching "Cops."
related_events: Ted switches screen to spreadsheet when Cam approaches
Cam observes and comments on police footage

name: Cam Confronts Ted About Being Left Off the Call
description: Cam approaches Ted and comments on the call he just returned from, saying it was exciting, like watching "Cops." Ted responds by noting the suspect was surprisingly agile despite having a herniated disc. Cam mentions he wasn’t included in the call, expressing mild frustration. Ted claims he couldn’t find him. Cam reminds him that the sooner others see him handling calls, the sooner Ted might be transferred back south. Ted replies that he’s heard that for 13 months and six days, and it’s getting old. Seeing Cam’s expression, Ted relents and says he’ll take him next time. Cam walks away. Ted answers the phone, keeping his eyes on the computer screen where a zombie lies in pieces from his game.
related_events: Cam confronts Ted about being excluded from a call
Ted makes sarcastic remark about Cam's repeated warning
Ted reassures Cam about future opportunities

name: Ted Finishes Game and Takes Call
description: After Cam walks away, Ted presses a final key, severing a zombie’s entrails on the computer screen. The phone rings. Without looking away from the game, he picks up the receiver and says, 'Claims, Ted Watters. Sure.'
related_events: Ted finishes killing a zombie in his computer game
Ted answers the phone while playing a violent computer game

name: Margaret and the Blocked Fridge
description: Margaret, still in her bathrobe, walks to the fridge and places her hand on the latch. She notices a pile of pop cans on the floor nearby. As she tugs on the door, it opens only a crack before being stopped by a chain. A frozen head appears through the narrow gap. Margaret sighs, then tries to push the door closed, but the body on the other side blocks it. She gives the door a hip check, forcing it shut with a loud crack from something inside. Unfazed, she walks away.
related_events: Margaret notices pile of pop cans near fridge
Fridge door opens partially due to chain restraint
Frozen head appears through fridge door gap

name: Margaret shuts the fridge door with her hip after it gets stuck
description: Margaret reaches for the fridge, but when she tries to close the door, it only opens a crack before being stopped by the chain. A frozen head appears through the gap. She pushes to close it, but the body inside blocks the door. She steps back and uses her hip to shove the door shut. A cracking sound comes from inside as the door latches. Without looking back, she walks away.
related_events: Margaret attempts to close fridge door but body blocks it
Margaret uses hip to shut fridge door
Something frozen cracks inside fridge during door closure

name: Margaret Walks Away from the Fridge
description: Margaret tugs on the fridge door, which opens only slightly before being stopped by the chain. A frozen head appears through the gap. She sighs, tries to push the door closed, but the body blocks it. She hip-checks the door, forcing it shut with a cracking sound from inside. Unfazed, she turns and walks away.
related_events: Margaret walks away from fridge unaware of contents

name: Howard and Ted Unload the Snowmobile
description: Howard stands in his driveway, struggling to unload a snowmobile from the back of his pickup truck. Snow covers the ground, and the bare branches of old pine trees rise around the quiet street. Ted Watters, a man in his late 50s wearing a heavy coat, walks by and stops. He offers to help. Howard accepts and asks him to grab two wooden planks. Ted picks up the boards, leans them against the truck's bumper to form a ramp. Howard guides the snowmobile down the incline, grunting with effort. The machine reaches the ground. Howard pulls off a mitten and shakes Ted's hand. He notices a small camcorder in Ted's other hand, pointed in his direction.
related_events: Howard attempts to unload snowmobile from pickup truck
Ted Watters offers assistance with unloading
Ted constructs wooden ramp to aid snowmobile descent
Howard guides snowmobile down improvised ramp
Howard successfully places snowmobile on the ground

name: Howard Confronts Ted After Discovering Secret Recording
description: After lowering the snowmobile to the ground, Howard pulls off his mitten and reaches out to shake Ted's hand. They begin talking about the snowmobile, with Howard commenting on its cost. As the conversation continues, Howard notices the camcorder in Ted's hands and sees that it's recording. He stops mid-sentence and demands to know why Ted is filming him.
related_events: Howard removes mitten to shake hands with Ted
Ted and Howard engage in conversation about snowmobile
Ted secretly records Howard with camcorder
Howard confronts Ted about camcorder recording

name: Ted and Howard's Interaction Played on VCR
description: The image shifts to show a television screen where the earlier scene between Ted and Howard unfolds in replay. The recording captures Howard struggling to unload the snowmobile, Ted offering help, fetching the wooden planks, and setting up the ramp. Howard thanks him, comments on the snowmobile's weight, and asks if Ted is the new neighbor. Ted introduces himself, they shake hands, and Howard mentions the cost of the vehicle. The moment Howard notices the camcorder, the screen flickers slightly, the playback continues, and the room around the TV remains dark and still.
related_events: Video footage of interaction plays on VCR

name: Paul Barnell Discusses Raymond's Life Insurance with Branch and Watters
description: Paul Barnell sits across from Frank Branch in an office lined with souvenirs—mounted fish, framed citations, photos of hockey teams. Branch introduces Ted Watters as he enters the room carrying a slim file. They exchange handshakes. Paul makes steady eye contact with Ted during the introduction. Seated, Ted flips open the file and asks about Raymond. Paul confirms it’s his brother and explains that Raymond has been missing for five years. He says it might be time to move on, adding that his father always wanted them to look out for each other. Money, he admits, is a little tight. Ted responds that without a body, Alaskan law requires a person to be missing for seven years before being declared legally dead, and even then, there could be an additional year for investigations or interventions. He closes the file. There’s little they can do, he says. Branch offers condolences, glancing at Ted, who nods in agreement.
related_events: Paul Barnell discusses brother's life insurance policy with Frank Branch and Ted Watters
Frank Branch introduces Ted Watters to Paul Barnell
Paul Barnell makes eye contact with Ted Watters during introduction
Ted Watters enters office with file and joins meeting

name: Ted Explains the Legal Hurdles to Claiming Raymond's Policy
description: Ted Watters sits across from Paul Barnell and Frank Branch, flipping open a slim file. He confirms that the missing man is Raymond Barnell, and listens as Paul explains that his brother has been gone for five years. Paul suggests it might be time to move forward, to cash in the life insurance policy. Ted interrupts gently, explaining that under Alaskan law, a person must be missing for seven years before they can be declared legally dead. He notes that without a body, the process cannot be accelerated, and even after seven years, there could be an additional year of investigations or interventions. As he speaks, he closes the file. The room falls quiet.
related_events: Ted Watters explains legal requirements for declaring Raymond Barnell dead
Ted Watters closes file indicating end of discussion

name: A Forced Smile After Sympathy
description: After the discussion about the life insurance policy, Frank Branch tells Paul Barnell they are extremely sorry for his loss. Ted Watters adds his agreement, though his tone is flat and distant. Frank glances at Ted, then offers a tight, forced smile, his expression shifting briefly as if responding to something unspoken between them.
related_events: Frank Branch expresses sympathy for Paul Barnell's loss
Ted Watters affirms sympathy after Paul Barnell's brother's presumed death
Frank Branch reacts to Ted Watters' demeanor with discomfort

name: Paul Prepares and Attaches Raw Bacon to a Baseball Cap
description: Paul stands over a sizzling frying pan full of bacon, holding a fork. He prods the bacon to check its consistency and, finding it still raw, lifts the strips out and places them on a plate. Nearby, a baseball cap and a stapler sit on the counter. Paul picks up each strip of bacon and fastens it to the peak of the cap with the stapler. The bacon hangs down loosely, dangling like fringe. Jodie the dog jumps at his feet, straining toward the cap. Margaret appears in the doorway and picks up the dog, who continues to reach for the bacon.
related_events: Paul checks bacon's consistency with a fork
Paul transfers uncooked bacon to a plate
Paul staples bacon strips to baseball cap

name: Margaret Arrives as Paul Staples Bacon to a Hat
description: Margaret appears in the doorway and calls out, 'Paul?' Startled, Paul exclaims, 'Holy-- Margaret, you scared the wits out of me.' She steps forward, lifts Jodie the dog into her arms as the dog strains toward the hat, and says, 'She just wants that bacon.' Paul, now calm, looks at her and asks, 'How late is "Rudys" open?'
related_events: Margaret appears in the doorway and calls out to Paul
Paul reacts with surprise to Margaret's sudden appearance
Margaret picks up Jodie the dog who is fixated on the bacon-laden hat
Paul inquires about the closing time of Rudys

name: Jodie Jumps for Bacon
description: Jodie the dog jumps up and down at Paul's feet as he stands over a sizzling frying pan full of bacon. The strips crackle as he checks them with a fork, then lifts them out and places them on a plate. Jodie continues to jump, her attention fixed on the bacon.
related_events: Jodie the dog reacts excitedly to cooking bacon

name: Margaret Confronts the Paperboy at the Door
description: Margaret Barnell, wearing a plush bathrobe and slippers, opens the front door to find the young paperboy standing there, smiling through the cold. He greets her and says it's twelve dollars, mentioning he missed her last time. She calls him a 'pussy little cocksucker' and tells him she'll get her purse. As she returns, she mutters 'jerk off... OK, jerk off, uhhuh' before handing him the money, the stamp card, and a dollar tip. She tweaks his nose twice, then tells him to say hi to his slut mom. He replies, 'Sure will. Thanks,' and trots down the walk as she shuts the door behind her.
related_events: Margaret Barnell greets paperboy at front door
Paperboy requests payment from Mrs. Barnell
Margaret Barnell verbally abuses paperboy

name: Margaret Retrieves Her Purse
description: After speaking to the paperboy, Margaret turns away from the door and walks into the house. She leaves the boy standing at the entrance as she goes to get her purse.
related_events: Margaret Barnell leaves to get her purse

name: Margaret Pays the Paperboy and Mocks Him
description: Margaret returns with her purse and hands the paperboy his payment, including the stamp card and an extra dollar. She reaches out and tweaks his nose twice. 'You say hi to your slut Mom for me?' she says. The paperboy smiles, pockets the money, and replies, 'Sure will. Thanks,' before walking down the path toward the street.
related_events: Margaret Barnell pays paperboy and gives him a tip
Margaret Barnell tweaks paperboy's nose twice
Paperboy agrees to deliver message to his mother

name: Paperboy Leaves and Margaret Closes the Door
description: The paperboy turned and walked down the path, making his way back from the front door. Margaret stepped inside and shut the door behind her.
related_events: Paperboy leaves front door area after interaction
Margaret Barnell shuts front door

name: Dave Demands Proof from Jimbo
description: Dave stares at Jimbo, his voice tight with suspicion. He tells Jimbo to take off his coat, then his shirt. Jimbo hesitates but obeys, shivering as he strips down in the cold. 'I'm not wearing a wire, Dave, if that's what this is about,' he says. Gary starts to remove his own coat, but a shout from the tobogganing hill distracts them. Gary's nephew has been shoved to the ground by a bully, who laughs as he slides away. Gary calls out that he needs to check on the boy and hurries toward the hill. Jimbo turns back to Dave, arms crossed over his bare chest, trying to stay warm. Dave demands proof—something concrete. 'You got a week,' he says. Then he gets into his car and drives off, leaving Jimbo standing in the cold as Gary returns with his sniffling nephew.
related_events: Dave questions Jimbo about being wired
Jimbo removes his coat and shirt under Dave's instruction
Dave demands proof from Jimbo and issues a one-week deadline

name: Gary Intervenes in the Hillside Attack on Billy
description: A fight breaks out on the tobogganing hill, and Gary sees his nephew being shoved to the ground by a bully. Without hesitation, he turns away from the tense conversation with Dave and Jimbo and trots toward the hill. Jimbo stares after him, incredulous, calling out that they’re in the middle of something. Gary calls back that he’s supposed to be looking after the boy. As Jimbo stands shivering, Gary tries to retrieve his nephew’s Snowrider from the bully, but the boy slides away, shouting insults. Gary returns to his nephew, who is sniffling, and suggests they stop at a toy store on the way back.
related_events: Bully shoves Gary's nephew to the ground on the tobogganing hill
Gary interrupts the confrontation to assist his nephew
Jimbo expresses disbelief at Gary leaving during a tense situation

name: Gary Tries to Get the Snowrider Back
description: After the bully shoves Gary's nephew to the ground, he grabs the Snowrider and slides away down the tobogganing hill. Gary runs after them, trying to catch up and retrieve the sled, but he is too slow. As the bully speeds off, he shouts insults back at them, calling them 'fag' and 'big homo' in a mocking tone. Gary stops at the bottom of the hill, watching helplessly as the bully disappears with the sled. He returns to his nephew, who is sniffling, and pats him on the shoulder.
related_events: Gary attempts to retrieve his nephew's Snowrider from the Bully on the tobogganing hill
Bully mocks Gary and his nephew while sliding away on the Snowrider

name: Gary Walks Back with His Nephew After the Toboggan Incident
description: Gary walks back from the tobogganing hill with his sniffling nephew, who is upset after being shoved to the ground. As they rejoin Jimbo and Dave, Gary suggests stopping at a toy store on the way home to buy a replacement Snowrider.
related_events: Gary walks back with his sniffling nephew and suggests stopping at a toy store

name: Paul Drives Jodie from the Body
description: Jodie, a small dog, enters the garage from the house and begins sniffing around the dead man. Paul reacts immediately, shouting 'Jodie, no! Not for dogs!' as he waves her away. He chases her back toward the house, shooing her until she leaves the garage. Once the dog is gone, Paul returns to the body.
related_events: Jodie enters the garage and sniffs the dead body
Paul shouts at Jodie to stop approaching the body
Paul shoos Jodie back into the house

name: Paul Forces the Body into the Fridge
description: Jodie, a small dog, enters the garage from the house and sniffs at the dead man, treating him like a new chew toy. Paul shouts at the dog and shoos it back inside. He returns to the refrigerator, opens the door, and struggles to fit the body inside. The man's legs resist, so Paul grabs one and kicks at the knee until it snaps sideways. He looks away, breathing hard, fighting nausea. With the leg now bent, the body fits. Paul leans against the fridge, catching his breath. He packs the remaining space with beer and soda bottles, then turns the temperature dial to the coldest setting. From beneath a propane BBQ, he takes a chain and padlock, securing the fridge shut. He notices some empty drink cans, kicks them into a corner, and walks into the house, calling out casually, "Hey Honey. Any mail?"
related_events: Paul attempts to store the dead man in the refrigerator
Paul breaks the dead man's leg to fit the body in the fridge
Paul leans against the fridge in exhaustion

name: Paul Secures the Body in the Fridge
description: After getting the man into the fridge, Paul fills the empty space around the body with beer and pop bottles. He reaches inside and turns the temperature dial to the coldest setting. From the base of a propane BBQ, he takes a chain and padlock, wraps it around the fridge door, and snaps the lock closed. He notices some leftover drink cans on the floor, kicks them into the corner, then walks back into the house.
related_events: Paul fills the remaining fridge space with beer and pop bottles
Paul sets the fridge temperature to the coldest setting
Paul secures the fridge with a padlock and chain from a propane BBQ

name: Paul cleans up and returns inside
description: Paul kicks the leftover drink cans to the corner of the garage. He walks back into the house and says, 'Hey Honey. Any mail?'
related_events: Paul kicks leftover drink cans to the corner of the garage
Paul re-enters the house and asks his wife about the mail

name: Paul Retrieves His Phone After a Sudden Scare at the Dumpster
description: A shout rings out as Paul jumps back from the dumpster. The lid slams down, and he scrambles away, sliding across the ground. He pauses, catching his breath, then remembers his phone is still inside. He steps forward, lifts the lid, and quickly reaches in, grabbing the phone before hurrying off. The lid crashes shut behind him.
related_events: Paul jumps back from the dumpster after a sudden shout
Dumpster lid crashes down as Paul retreats
Paul retrieves his phone from the dumpster

name: Paul Aborts 911 Call and Pauses
description: After retrieving his phone from the dumpster, Paul dials 911. He looks back at the dumpster, then presses end on the call. He stands still, staring at the dumpster, silent and motionless.
related_events: Paul attempts to call 911 but aborts the call
Paul stands thinking after aborting the emergency call

name: Paul Watches the Dumpster and Reacts to a Passing Truck
description: Paul stands in his office at Barnell Great Escapes Travel, staring out the window at the dumpster in the parking area. Behind him, two Repo-Men carry a computer monitor toward the door, but he doesn't notice. A truck rumbles by on the road, and Paul quickly turns his head toward the sound. Seeing that the truck is not stopping, he remains still for a moment, then turns his gaze back to the dumpster.
related_events: Paul stares at the dumpster from his office window while Repo-Men remove a computer monitor
Paul reacts to the sound of a passing garbage truck

name: Paul Climbs into the Dumpster
description: Moments later, Paul backs his Ford Taurus up to the dumpster. He checks to make sure he is alone, then opens the lid and climbs inside.
related_events: Paul drives his Ford Taurus to the dumpster and climbs inside

name: Paul Returns Home to a Cold Dinner and Tensions with Margaret
description: Paul returns home to find Margaret in the kitchen, preparing dinner. He opens the oven to check on the chicken and finds it stone cold. He suggests they order in instead. As Margaret considers wine, Paul tells her that Raymond is back. His smile fades as he watches her reaction. Without a word, Margaret turns and rushes out of the room.
related_events: Paul checks the chicken in the oven
Paul suggests ordering dinner instead
Paul reveals Raymond has returned
Margaret storms out of the room

name: Paul Mocks Raymond at the Anniversary Party
description: At a 10th anniversary celebration in a VFW hall decorated with a Caribbean theme, Raymond stands apart from the festive crowd, not dressed in tropical attire. A slightly drunk Paul steps into view, puts an arm around his brother, and teases him, calling him jealous. He reaches over and messes up Raymond's hair. Raymond shakes Paul's arm off, his face darkening. Without warning, he grabs Paul by the lapels and hurls him to the floor. The room falls silent as the laughter dies out.
related_events: Paul provokes Raymond at the celebration
Raymond confronts Paul at anniversary celebration
Raymond throws Paul to the floor
related_occasions: 10Th Anniversary Bon Voyage Celebration At Vfw Hall

name: Paul Finds Documents and Applies for a Credit Card in Raymond's Name
description: Paul watches a home video on a small TV while sitting at his desk. In front of him, a cardboard box holds old documents, souvenirs, and report cards. He pulls out a faded hotel postcard from Hawaii and sets it aside, then removes an insurance policy. He flips to the last page, which lists payouts for various injuries and accidental death. He continues digging and finds Raymond's birth certificate. He places it on the desk, takes out a credit card application from work, and begins writing. He fills in the name: Raymond Barnell.
related_events: Paul discovers Raymond's birth certificate in cardboard box
Paul fills out credit card application with Raymond's information

name: Margaret Laughs Off Drink Spill on Cruise
description: On a cruise ship, Margaret lies sunbathing as Paul films her with a handheld camera. A waiter approaches with a tray of tropical drinks and accidentally dumps one on her. Instead of reacting with anger, Margaret bursts into laughter. She tells the waiter it's okay, not to worry, and asks for the next drink in a cup.
related_events: Waiter spills tropical drink on Margaret on cruise ship
Margaret laughs off drink spill and requests replacement

name: Gary and Jimbo Search the Garbage Bin
description: Gary and Jimbo glance around to make sure no one is watching, then lift the lid of a garbage bin. Gary leans in and begins digging through the trash. Jimbo stands nearby, scanning the area, his posture tense as he keeps watch.
related_events: Gary and Jimbo check for observers before opening the garbage bin
Gary burrows through the garbage in the bin
Jimbo keeps watch while Gary searches the bin

name: Gary and Jimbo Search the Bin
description: The lid of the bin creaks open as Gary and Jimbo peer inside, making sure they’re not being watched. Gary, slight and quick, climbs in and starts digging through the garbage. The air is cold, the waste frozen. He wrinkles his nose. 'I thought stuff didn’t smell when it was frozen?' Jimbo stands guard, tense, his eyes darting around. 'Dave wants visual confirmation, he gets visual confirmation,' he says. 'We have a chance to move up here, so let’s just—' Gary interrupts, 'Like the guy’s not gonna end up in a landfill, anyway.' He hums a tune, still digging, then stops. 'So how’d it feel? I mean, not when you did it, but, like now?' Jimbo doesn’t answer. Gary hops deeper into the bin, movements growing frantic. Nothing. He climbs out. 'Not here.' Jimbo glares. 'Serious. He’s gone.' Gary looks around. 'Maybe he wasn’t…' 'Don’t even joke. Maybe the trash was emptied.' 'Looks pretty full.' Gary crouches, spotting something. 'Hey… there’s a little fridge down here.' He stands. 'If we would have shot him at least we’d know for sure.' Jimbo turns away. 'I was following orders. And if you hadn’t started a screaming match, no one would have called the cops and we wouldn’t have had to dump his—' 'Fine. Sorry.' 'Fine.' Gary kicks at the trash. 'I’m just saying… maybe you didn’t break it all the way.' 'It was broken.' 'I’m just saying… maybe it was like hypothermia and he just looked dead.' Jimbo snaps, 'It - was - BROKEN!' Gary flinches, then silently resumes digging with his feet.
related_events: Gary questions Jimbo about the frozen body and Dave's orders
Jimbo argues with Gary about the disposal of the frozen body

name: Gary Asks How It Felt
description: Gary stops searching through the garbage and looks at Jimbo. He asks how it felt, not when it happened, but now. Jimbo tells him he doesn’t want to talk about it. Gary presses, suggesting maybe the man wasn’t really dead, that his neck might not have been fully broken. Jimbo cuts him off, insisting it was broken. He turns away. Gary, quiet for a moment, starts digging through the trash again, this time with his feet.
related_events: Gary asks Jimbo how it feels to have committed the act
Jimbo refuses to discuss his feelings about the act

name: Gary Searches the Bin and Finds Nothing
description: Gary hums to himself as he digs through the garbage, finding nothing. He climbs into the bin, searching more frantically, then hops out and stands, coming to the conclusion that the body or item is not there. He says it's gone, suggesting the trash might not have been emptied after all.
related_events: Gary hums and continues searching the garbage without success
Gary hops into the garbage bin in a frantic search
Gary concludes the item is not in the garbage bin

name: Gary Questions the Body's Death
description: Gary digs through the garbage bin, muttering about the frozen body and wondering if the man might still be alive—suggesting hypothermia or an incomplete kill. Jimbo cuts him off, shouting that the body was broken beyond recovery, his voice firm and angry. Gary flinches, falls silent, and, embarrassed, begins poking through the trash with his feet instead.
related_events: Gary speculates about the frozen body's condition and possible survival
Gary searches the garbage bin with his feet after becoming embarrassed

name: Paul Identifies His Brother's Body at the Crime Scene
description: Paul walks toward the covered corpse with Detective Boyle. Boyle warns him that the body is badly damaged. He pulls back the tarp, revealing the man's face. Paul looks at it closely, then nods. He says the animals chewed his brother's ears off. Boyle covers the body again and hands Paul a plastic bag containing his brother's wallet. A police officer leads Paul away from the scene.
related_events: Paul identifies his brother's body
Detective Boyle informs Paul about the cause of death
related_occasions: Crime Scene Investigation At The Corpse Recovery Site

name: Paul Receives His Brother's Wallet and Is Led Away
description: After confirming the body under the tarp was his brother, Paul stands quietly, clutching the sea shell he had brought from his office. Detective Boyle hands him a clear plastic bag containing his brother's wallet. Paul looks at it without speaking. Officer Marcie approaches and gently guides him away from the scene as he lowers his head.
related_events: Detective Boyle returns the victim's personal effects
Paul presents a sea shell as a memento from his brother
Police officer Marcie escorts Paul away after identification
related_occasions: Crime Scene Investigation At The Corpse Recovery Site

name: Detective Boyle Examines Bite Marks and Bacon at Crime Scene
description: A female officer approaches Detective Boyle and points out smaller bite marks on the victim's ankle. Boyle studies the marks and mutters that pups must have been involved, suggesting the whole pack attacked. Another officer arrives holding a clear evidence bag containing a strip of bacon found at the scene. Boyle shakes his head, remarking that it wasn't the smartest snack for a hiker. The officer notes how messy the animals were. Boyle repeats the word 'messy' several times under his breath. He looks at the covered body and asks if an autopsy is really necessary given how little remains.
related_events: Female cop reports smaller bite marks found on the victim's ankle
Female cop presents evidence of a strip of bacon found at the scene
Detective Boyle comments on the presence of pups and a pack of animals
Detective Boyle questions the need for an autopsy given the state of the body
related_occasions: Crime Scene Investigation At The Corpse Recovery Site

name: Detective Boyle Tells Paul How the Body Was Found
description: Detective Boyle stands near the corpse, speaking with Paul. He explains that an anonymous tip from a man in Jamaica led them to the site—the man had seen what looked like a body. Using the victim’s ID, police traced the family. Paul blinks in surprise and says it sounds just like something from a TV show. Detective Boyle nods. Paul then asks to see his brother. He moves toward the tarp-covered body, and Boyle warns him it’s not a sight he’ll easily forget. Paul insists. Boyle lifts the tarp, revealing the badly damaged face. Paul leans in, recognizes him, and says the animals chewed his ears off. Boyle covers the body again and hands Paul a bag with the victim’s wallet inside. A police officer named Marcie leads Paul away.
related_events: Detective Boyle reveals the anonymous tip led to the discovery
related_occasions: Crime Scene Investigation At The Corpse Recovery Site

name: Paul Arrives at the Shop on a Snowy Morning
description: Paul arrives at the shop and pulls at the front door, which is blocked by a small pile of snow. After three strong yanks, the door gives way and he steps inside. He hangs up his coat, shivering, and moves toward his desk. Avis, standing nearby, smiles and offers him coffee. She mentions the weather, commenting that without it, people would have nothing to talk about. Paul thanks her and asks if there were any calls. Avis replies that only a man from Municipal Power and Electric called, but she told him the check had already been sent. Paul sets down the mail she hands him and begins flipping through it.
related_events: Paul struggles to open front door blocked by snow
Paul enters the shop after opening the door
Paul moves to his desk and inquires about calls
Avis offers Paul coffee and discusses weather

name: Avis Sets Up the New Aloha Airlines Display
description: Avis assembles a life-size cardboard stand-up for Aloha Airlines, featuring a Hawaiian woman holding a large seashell that juts out from the display. Once it's in place, she picks up the old Aloha Air surfboard display and carries it toward the back of the shop.
related_events: Avis assembles Aloha Airlines cardboard display
Avis removes old Aloha Air surfboard display to the back

name: Paul Receives Mail and Coffee While Exchanging Updates with Avis
description: Paul flips through the mail Avis brings him, sorting through a stack of bills marked past due. He sets aside a pre-approved credit card application. Avis mentions a call from Municipal Power and Electric, reminding Paul she told them the check had already been sent weeks ago. She hands him his coffee and the rest of the mail, then continues working nearby as they talk.
related_events: Paul receives mail and reviews past-due bills
Avis reports call from Municipal Power and Electric
Avis delivers coffee and mail to Paul

name: Paul Tells Avis About Raymond's Return
description: Paul looks at a photo of his wife on his desk, then turns to Avis. He tells her that something strange happened the night before—there was a knock at the door, and when he answered, his brother Raymond was standing there. Raymond, who had been missing for years, said nothing at first, just appeared on the doorstep. Paul shares this with Avis as she brings him coffee and the mail.
related_events: Paul reflects on his wife and gathers himself
Paul mentions strange occurrence involving his brother Raymond
Raymond appears at Paul's door last night

name: Paul Lies About Raymond's Whereabouts
description: Avis asks where Raymond was living during his years away. Paul, distracted by the sight of the Hawaiian shell on the Aloha Airlines display, hesitates and then says Florida. When Avis mentions she has an aunt there and asks for the specific location, Paul falters, then replies it was a small place by the beach.
related_events: Paul lies about Raymond's location in Florida

name: Avis Asks About Margaret's Health
description: Avis sets down the coffee and mail on Paul's desk. She looks at him and asks how his wife Margaret is doing. Paul pauses, then says she’s better, a little better, and that some days are better than others.
related_events: Avis inquires about Margaret's health

name: Ted Avoids Moose While Driving Home
description: Ted drives through a wooded area, flipping through radio stations until he lands on 'Escape (The Piña Colada Song).' As he listens, a moose steps into the road ahead. Ted slams the brakes, and the car skids to a stop a few feet from the animal. The moose stands still, looking at the car, then slowly walks off into the trees. Ted remains in the driver's seat for a moment before pulling away and continuing down the road.
related_events: Ted listens to "Escape (The Piña Colada Song)" on the radio
Ted drives through wooded area and encounters moose on road

name: Ted Comes Home to Tiffany
description: Ted unlocks the door and steps into the apartment, calling out a quiet 'Hey Tiff.' Tiffany, seated at a desk with a headset on, holds up a folder marked 'WORKING - SHHHHHH!' without looking. He walks to the kitchen, peels off his winter coat, and opens the fridge. She appears behind him, grabs a Diet Coke, and kisses him on the cheek. He stirs a container of food with a fork, asking about the stew. She tells him it might not be good anymore. He sits at the table and eats, humming along to a song in his head. She returns to her desk, flips through a magazine, and speaks into the headset, asking a caller about sofa cushions.
related_events: Ted arrives home and interacts with Tiffany in the kitchen

name: Tiffany Conducts a Psychic Reading for Mr. Williams
description: Tiffany sits at her desk, feet propped up, wearing a headset connected to her computer. The phone rings, and she watches as the caller’s information appears on her screen—name, address, background, and all. By the second ring, she presses enter and speaks into the headset. "Psychic Pals. How are you today, Mr. Williams?" She listens for a moment, then says, "Well, we are all registered psychics here. I just had a feeling you'd be calling. What's up?" After a pause, she continues, "I need you to clear your mind..." She flips through a copy of "Cosmo" with one hand while speaking. "Mr. Williams, I'm seeing sofa cushions. Do you have a sofa? Good. Glad I could help."
related_events: Tiffany answers psychic hotline call from Mr. Williams
Tiffany provides psychic reading about sofa cushions

name: Tiffany Takes Calls from Carol and Margaret at Psychic Pals
description: Tiffany sits at her desk, feet propped up, wearing her headset as the phone rings. She answers and speaks to Carol, telling her that God is currently occupied with a famine in Africa but wants her to keep praying. After a pause, the phone rings again. She logs the incoming number, sees the name Margaret Barnell appear on the screen along with her address and background, then picks up the second call. Tiffany listens, then tells Margaret she’s picking up on emotional distress caused by someone close to her. As she speaks, Ted walks by, tossing a dish towel over his shoulder, and gives her a teasing look. Tiffany rolls her eyes slightly but keeps her voice steady on the phone, continuing to guide Margaret through the reading.
related_events: Tiffany answers a call from Carol at Psychic Pals
Tiffany relays message from God to Carol about ongoing famine
Tiffany answers a new call from a caller named Margaret Barnell at Psychic Pals
Tiffany relays intuitive message to Margaret about someone she cares about causing distress

name: Tiffany Tries to Give Ted a Love Quiz
description: Tiffany flips through a copy of 'Cosmo' with her feet up on the desk, still wearing her headset. She sets the magazine down, turns to Ted, and holds up a page. "Let's do this love quiz together." Ted, sitting at the table with a fork in his hand, shakes his head. "No way. That stuff's made up." He gestures around the apartment. "You're running a psychic hotline from our living room. How is that not a scam?" Tiffany leans back, crossing her arms. "It's not a scam. People believe in it. And you just don't like it because I make more than you do." Ted smirks. "Oh, so now it's 'our living room'? You said 'my apartment' last week when I forgot to take out the trash." She points at him. "You used 'my' when you ordered pizza last night. Possessive, much?" He rolls his eyes, then closes them, pressing his fingers to his temples. "I'm concentrating. I sense... you're going to keep bugging me until I play along." Tiffany laughs, covering her mouth with the magazine. Ted opens one eye, watching her, and a small smile crosses his face.
related_events: Tiffany fixes a software bug in a beta version
Tiffany attempts to administer love quiz to Ted
Ted refuses to participate in the love quiz
Ted confronts Tiffany about running a scam from their living room
Tiffany advises Margaret to channel her rage while playfully challenging Ted's wording
Ted pretends to concentrate, causing Tiffany to giggle
